title: INK SHEAR
description: Stateful pigment filaments negotiate a persistent vortex field instead of following a clock. Dragging writes momentum and eddies into the liquid; viscosity, curl, bleed and memory move the work between laminar marbling, torn ribbons and dense turbulent knots.

visual_finish.composition: three offset pigment currents cross a dark paper field, leaving broad negative space and an asymmetrical central shear zone
visual_finish.material_model: wet translucent ink with saturated cores, diluted feathering and pooled overlap density
